bear_assumptions: FY27 revenue guidance midpoint of USD 5.9367 billion grows 18% to USD 7.005 billion; normalized free-cash-flow margin is 26%; a 35 times FCF multiple, USD 3.807 billion April net cash and 1.05 billion post-split diluted shares reflect slower platform growth, SBC dilution and continuing July 19 incident exposure.
base_assumptions: FY27 revenue guidance midpoint of USD 5.9367 billion grows 22% to USD 7.243 billion; normalized free-cash-flow margin is 30%; a 45 times FCF multiple, USD 3.807 billion April net cash and 1.04 billion post-split diluted shares credit durable ARR growth and platform economics while explicitly normalizing stock compensation.
bull_assumptions: FY27 revenue guidance midpoint of USD 5.9367 billion grows 26% to USD 7.480 billion; normalized free-cash-flow margin is 34%; a 55 times FCF multiple, USD 3.807 billion April net cash and 1.03 billion post-split diluted shares require sustained AI and platform acceleration, strong retention, widening margins and limited dilution or incident liability.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh primary evidence and a new scenario set clear the canonical expected-return, base-upside, bear/base payoff, expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and relationship gates; downgrade the business thesis if ARR growth, retention, platform adoption, normalized cash conversion or net cash deteriorate, or July 19 incident liabilities materially exceed the modeled risk.
